definitions.explanation: Something that sets off or encourages an event, illness or action without being its whole cause: a trigger for a disease, a factor that prompts a crime, an incentive that makes people act. A written word used in medicine, economics and analysis.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誘因|ゆういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誘因|ゆういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To investigate what triggered the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{投資|とうし}→投資：04711_toushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧{誘因|ゆういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えられている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Lowering taxes is thought to give companies an incentive to invest more.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誘因|ゆういん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be a trigger for
- ⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誘因|ゆういん}: what triggers an attack
- {誘因|ゆういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧: to remove the trigger
